verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, hosted MCP endpoint, or agent connectivity of any kind. The natural-language audience-building feature (docs-16/22) is a different capability and does not count, and REST APIs and SDKs are only developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
